after.title: Platinum Choice - World of Hyatt Category 1-4 Free Night Award
after.description: 1 World of Hyatt Category 1-4 Free Night Award selectable as a Platinum Medallion Choice Benefit starting with the 2028 Medallion Year (beginning February 1, 2027).
after.expiration_note: Per Medallion Year (available beginning Feb 1, 2027 for 2028 Medallion Year Choice Benefit selections).
after.notes: Requires linked Delta SkyMiles and World of Hyatt accounts. Available beginning February 1, 2027 as a 2028 Medallion Year Choice Benefit; not available for 2026 or 2027 Medallion Year Choice Benefit selections.

changes.summary: New Platinum Medallion Choice Benefit option for the 2028 Medallion Year, selectable from February 1, 2027: a World of Hyatt Category 1-4 Free Night Award.

after.title: Diamond Choice - World of Hyatt Category 1-7 Free Night Award
after.description: 1 World of Hyatt Category 1-7 Free Night Award selectable as a Diamond Medallion Choice Benefit starting with the 2028 Medallion Year (beginning February 1, 2027).
after.expiration_note: Per Medallion Year (available beginning Feb 1, 2027 for 2028 Medallion Year Choice Benefit selections).
after.notes: Requires linked Delta SkyMiles and World of Hyatt accounts. Available beginning February 1, 2027 as a 2028 Medallion Year Choice Benefit; not available for 2026 or 2027 Medallion Year Choice Benefit selections. Delta has not yet specified whether this option consumes 1 or multiple Diamond Choice selections.

changes.summary: New Diamond Medallion Choice Benefit option for the 2028 Medallion Year, selectable from February 1, 2027: a World of Hyatt Category 1-7 Free Night Award.
